daily-ai-briefing.prompt: Search the web for important AI/ML research from the past 24 hours. Focus on LLM reasoning, agent frameworks, transformer improvements, and open-weight models. Prefer primary sources such as arXiv and major research labs. Select the three most important items, verify the source for each claim, and report a concise technical summary, source URL, confidence level, and why it matters. If fewer than three quality items are available, report only the verified items rather than padding the briefing.

weekly-paper-digest.prompt: Research notable arXiv papers from the past 7 days on language-model reasoning, agent/tool use, and transformer efficiency. Select up to three strong papers per category by relevance and evidence. For each paper record title, authors, arXiv ID, submission date, a concise abstract-based summary, key contribution, methodology highlight, and verified code link when available. Create Obsidian notes under Research/Papers/ only when the Obsidian skill is configured. Deliver a cited summary locally.
